Management sat down one-on-one with Legacy trainers and ranked what holds the business back. In order:

Priority 01Highest

Lead generation

The schedule fills from whoever walks up. When that slows down, there's no steady way to start new conversations, and the "not yets" never hear back.

What fixes it

A page that books consults and a system that answers every inquiry.

→
Priority 02

Marketing

Socials and websites. Great work on the floor that nobody sees online, and no professional page to send people to.

What fixes it

Business systems

Contracts, waivers, onboarding, reminders, renewals and reviews live in your head and your texts. It works until it doesn't.

What fixes it

One system that does the follow-up the same way every time.
